_doc: A stampede's falls (specification 003 T008, Pwalkers-12, Prender-270): a blow of force 2 on the street corner at (60, 8), where people walk, with the clock running; it knocks nobody down, so who lies on the ground tripped (trips.cpp), fell forwards and put their hands out (Ragdoll::begin brace). Two and a half and five seconds after it, near (40 px a metre) from 50 degrees at four azimuths and from above (80); by day.
